clue.text: Notice about a part to be cast on its own

indicators.note: the word for noticing is wrapped around the other piece

parts.note: to notice something is to see it

indicators.note: a part to be cast is thrown into a fresh arrangement, so its letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: A director pins up a notice about a role that is to be cast on its own.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be cast' looks like theatre casting but signals the anagram of A PART, giving PARAT inside the word for notice.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something kept on its own is apart, distinct and detached from the rest.

clue.text: Remarkable network soldiers erected

indicators.note: in a down clue, putting something up means reading it from the bottom

parts.note: LAN stands for local area network
GIs are American soldiers

explanation.surface: Soldiers set up a remarkable network.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a signal achievement is notable and outstanding.

clue.text: I try to shred up Polish dumplings

indicators.note: in a down clue the pieces are read from the bottom

parts.note: to have a go is to try
to rip is to tear or shred

explanation.surface: A cook resolves to shred something up for Polish dumplings.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: stuffed dough dumplings from Polish and Eastern European cooking.

clue.text: Cyclist shot by a bank robber?

indicators.note: the cyclist is pierced as if shot through, with the single letter going inside

parts.note: a cyclist is a rider

explanation.surface: A cyclist is shot by a bank robber.
explanation.definitionFit: Example, marked by the question mark: one who carries out a raid on a bank.

clue.text: Snatch baby and invite reprimand

parts.note: to snatch is to take
a tot is a small child
to invite is to ask

explanation.surface: Kidnapping a baby is just asking for a telling-off.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: the phrase means to criticise or scold someone for a fault.

clue.text: Accounts written across blackboards

indicators.note: the stories are set down on either side of the letter, spanning it

parts.note: accounts are stories or tales
the first part of the word, black, is abbreviated B, as on pencils

explanation.surface: Bookkeeping figures chalked up across classroom blackboards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blackboards' does two jobs: its first part, black, gives B (the usual abbreviation), and its second part, boards, is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a board is an old word for a table, as in bed and board or the festive board.

clue.text: A wizard takes company over current strength

indicators.note: the wizard takes the reversed troupe inside him

parts.note: a mage is a wizard

indicators.note: the theatre company is turned over, reading backwards

parts.note: a rep is a repertory theatre company

explanation.surface: A wizard takes over a company because its strength is current.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' reverses the company word to PER, and 'current' is electrical, not 'present'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the size of an electric current, measured in amps.

clue.text: Look through window to see legendary adulterer

indicators.note: the window has the other word passing through it

parts.note: a lancet is a tall narrow pointed window
lo is an old exclamation meaning look

explanation.surface: A peeping Tom looks through a window and spots a famous adulterer.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the Arthurian knight whose affair with Queen Guinevere brought down the Round Table.

clue.text: Reserve time in holiday area

indicators.note: the letter goes inside the resort word

parts.note: the seaside is where British people traditionally go on holiday

explanation.surface: Someone keeps some time spare in the holiday area.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to keep something back for later use, as in setting money by.

clue.text: Pungent fish taste variable

parts.note: a gar is a long-snouted fish
to taste something you might lick it
Y is a letter used for an algebraic variable

explanation.surface: A strong-smelling fish dish whose taste varies.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: food heavy with the bulb's oil has a strong, sharp smell and flavour.

clue.text: Way to incorporate wood in old instrument

indicators.note: the abbreviation for a road takes the timber word into its body

parts.note: ST, short for street, is a way
pine is a kind of wood

explanation.surface: A method of building timber into an antique musical instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a small harpsichord-like keyboard instrument of the 17th and 18th centuries.

clue.text: Get irate, tickled by feather

indicators.note: the angry words are stirred and played about with, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone loses their temper on being tickled with a feather.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an egret's plume, or a spray of plumes worn as an ornament on a hat.

clue.text: Leaves money for sex

parts.note: green is American slang for money, from the colour of dollar bills
S is an abbreviation for sex, as on forms

explanation.surface: Someone walks out, leaving cash in exchange for sex.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leaves' looks like a verb but is the noun: leafy vegetables.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: leafy vegetables such as cabbage and kale are leaves eaten as food.

clue.text: Exercise is said to be well done

definitions.meaning: the common claim that exercise benefits health

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: beneficial to health, and a cheer of congratulation, sometimes sarcastic.

clue.text: Fort betrayed as throng poured in

indicators.note: the scrambled crowd goes inside the word for betrayed

parts.note: someone betrayed has been sold out

indicators.note: the crowd pouring in is in disorder, so its letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A fortress was betrayed when a crowd poured in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'poured' turns THRONG into TRONGH, which goes 'in' SOLD.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a fortified place that holds out against attack.

clue.text: Verse minister cut and cut again

indicators.note: the cleric is cut short, losing the final letter

parts.note: a cleric is a minister of religion
to hew is to cut, the second cut in the clue

explanation.surface: A poem about a minister being cut and cut again.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a comic four-line biographical poem, named after inventor Edmund Clerihew Bentley.

clue.text: Say coffee's popular? I may wear that

indicators.note: the phrase is spoken aloud, giving a word with the same sound

parts.note: coffee is mocha and popular is in, so the phrase is mocha's in

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether coffee is fashionable, and says they might wear it.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a riddle: 'I' is a foot that may wear the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a soft leather slipper, originally Native American footwear, worn on the foot.

clue.text: Ease university means of admission to let one in

indicators.note: the letters let another piece come inside them

parts.note: MIT is the Massachusetts Institute of Technology
a gate is a way in
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A university eases its entry rules to let someone in.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to mitigate is to lessen the severity of something.

clue.text: Invitation from Amazon ladies team, welcoming family

indicators.note: the toilet-plus-team pair takes the relatives in

parts.note: the ladies is a toilet, a loo
a team is a side
kin are family

explanation.surface: An Amazon warrior women's team welcomes a family.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Amazon' suggests the mythical warrior women, but it is the online bookshop, whose preview button carries this phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: the online retailer's button inviting shoppers to browse a book's pages before buying.

clue.text: Succeeded heading off bully in area

parts.note: S is an abbreviation for succeeded, used in family trees

indicators.note: the bully word loses its first letter

parts.note: to hector is to bully

explanation.surface: Someone succeeds in seeing off a bully in the area.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a sector is a distinct part or zone of a region.

clue.text: Who left in two-seater?

indicators.note: the letter goes inside the car

parts.note: a coupé is a two-door car with seats for two

explanation.surface: A question asking who drove away in a sports car.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines too: a two-seater holds a pair of people.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a pair of people, just right for a two-seater car.

clue.text: Slowcoach ropes me in, for one, to move up in race situation

indicators.note: in a down clue moving up means the letters read from the bottom
the word me is roped in for, or in place of, the one

parts.note: a snail is a byword for a slowcoach
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A slowcoach in a race ropes someone in to help them move up the field.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ropes me in, for one' means 'me' replaces the I, giving SNAMEL, which 'to move up' reads from the bottom.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the French town that hosts the famous 24-hour motor race.

clue.text: Start back having contraceptive on order regularly

indicators.note: one piece sits on, or after, the other
taking every other letter of the word order, the second and fourth

parts.note: a coil is an intrauterine contraceptive device

explanation.surface: Someone flinches at having contraception supplied regularly to order.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to start back is to flinch or spring back in fright or disgust.

clue.text: I protest domain name used by Spain is not unique

indicators.note: the four-letter piece appears more than once, so it is doubled
the domain ending is followed by the country letter

parts.note: com is the common internet domain ending
E is the international vehicle code for Spain

explanation.surface: Someone complains that a Spanish web address is shared with others.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a reproachful exclamation meaning 'now really', said to object to something.

clue.text: Cavalryman's shout of joy heard

indicators.note: the cheer is said out loud, giving a word that sounds like it

parts.note: huzza is an old cheer of joy

explanation.surface: A cavalry soldier lets out a cheer that everyone hears.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a light cavalry soldier, originally from Hungary.

clue.text: 1984, for one, appearing good in among today's chaos

indicators.note: the abbreviation for good goes in among the scrambled letters
the letters of the word for the present day are thrown into disorder

parts.note: PI, short for pious, is crossword shorthand for good

explanation.surface: Orwell's novel appears to be good amid modern chaos.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chaos' rearranges the letters of today's into DYSTOA before the abbreviation for good is placed among them.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Orwell's Nineteen Eighty-Four is the classic novel of a nightmarish future society.

clue.text: Graves perhaps containing bone (radius), found in "dead" time

indicators.note: the wine holds the cut of steak's letter inside it

parts.note: Graves is a wine from the Bordeaux region of France
T as in T-bone, the steak named after its T-shaped bone

explanation.surface: Graves laced with bone and a radius are found in the time of death.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Graves' suggests burial, but it is a Bordeaux wine. 'containing' puts T inside WINE, then R follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: the coldest season, when plants are dormant, is the 'dead' part of the year.

clue.text: Severely reduces living space

definitions.meaning: cuts into four, so by drastic amounts
lodgings or rooms where people live

explanation.surface: Cutbacks harshly shrink people's homes.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: to cut drastically into four, and accommodation, especially for troops.
